contexts.text: The voice of Jehovah God... () = a dictate... (for) in the Word,the voice of Jehovah stands for the Word itself, the doctrine of faith, conscience or internal advertence, and also the consequent reproof; and therefore even thunderbolts are called voices of Jehovah. Illustrated.
A voice = revelation. Illustrated.
The voice of one crying () = the annunciation of the Lord's advent; in general, for every (such) annunciation, as with the regenerate, who have a dictate.
The voice of thy brother's bloods () = violence inflicted on charity. In the Word, voice stands for everything that accuses.
A voice crying, and the voice of a cry, is a wonted formula of the Word, and is applied to any case in which a noise, tumult, or disturbance, and also in which anything happy, occurs. Illustrated.
I have spoken with many (Spirits) in as clear a voice, although internal, as with friends here.
There is an image of the deceit in every tone of the voice.
The voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying () = chat there shall not be evil, nor falsity. AC 2351.
She lifted up her voice and wept () = a further degree of grief. For to lift up the voice and weep = the last degree of grief, because weeping with an uplifted voice is nothing else.
God heard the voice of the boy () = aid then. Explained.
The voice is the voice of Jacob () = that in this case the Intellectual of truth was within... thus in inverted order. For voice is predicated of truth.

Voice (or a word) without affection, is like the voice of an automaton, thus is only sound without life; but in proportion to the degree and the quality of affection there is in it, in the same proportion is the degree and the quality of the life in it.

For Spirits and Angels have, among themselves, a sonorous voice; and are heard by one another as well as a man is heard by a man; but human singing is not to be compared, in sweetness and harmony, with theirs.
He shall send forth His Angels with... a great voice () = election; not that this is done by... great voices, but by the influx of... holy truth... A trumpet and a great voice = evangelization.
It matters not from whom the voice of good and truth proceeds...
But those who are not in good and truth can have no revelation from perception, but by a living voice heard in them... This revelation is external.
The voices, etc. which proceeded out of the throne () = the terrors caused by the Divine truth with those who are not in good.

The voice was heard in Pharaoh's house () = that this infilled the universal Natural; for a voice which is heard elsewhere, and at a distance, when predicated of influx. = to infill; for as a voice which is heard infills, so does that which inflows.
When I heard Spirits speaking to me, I could perceive, merely from the tone of voice of the speech, whether they spoke from what was simulated, etc.
The voice of Jehovah () = the Divine truth.
If they do not hear the voice of the former sign () = if they do not obey what is announced from the Word... A voice = what is announced from the Word. AC 6971:3, Illustrated.
A voice is often predicated of... things which do not belong to a voice. Illustrated.
A voice = annunciation; and, in a good sense, annunciation from the Word, which voice is called the voice of Jehovah. Illustrated.
A voice = Divine truth, thus the Word, and annunciation from it. Illustrated.
That voice and speech from the Divine are neither heard nor perceived. Signified, Explained.

Mouth = voice... because it is the organ of the voice (whereas the tongue is the organ of speech). The difference between voice and speech is evident to everyone; and also that to be heard is predicated of voice, and to be perceived, of speech.
The last mediation (by which the Divine truth passes to man) is by a Spirit with the man, who inflows either into his thought, or by a living voice.

Who is Jehovah that I should hear His voice () = contrary thought about the Lord in respect to hearkening to His exhortation; for voice, here, = exhortation... thus to hear the voice = to obey or hearken to the exhortation.

Jehovah gave voices () = the recession and separation of the communication with those who are in good and truth; for the voices, which were those of thunders, = the Divine truths which enlighten and perfect those who are in Heaven, and terrify and devastate those who are in Hell; and, as they devastate these, they (have the above signification). AC 7592. AC 7597.
That the voices, which are those of thunders = the truths Divine which enlighten and perfect those who are in Heaven, and terrify and devastate those who are in Hell. Illustrated.
Their voice resounds like the sea () = the derivative reasoning.
If... thou wilt hear the voice of Jehovah thy God () = faith in the precepts of the Lord... The voice of Jehovah = what is enunciated from the Word, thus the precept of the Lord.

Its voice as the voice of wheels, and as the voice of Shaddai (, etc.) = (the quality of Divine truth in Heaven); for... voice is attributed to Divine truth; and it is therefore said the voice of great waters, because waters = truths; and the voice of the wheels, because wheels = the truths of doctrinal things; and also the voice of God Shaddai, because God Shaddai = truth chiding in temptation and afterwards consoling. References.
If... ye will hear My voice () = the reception of truth; for... the voice of Jehovah = the Word, thus truth Divine. References.
There were voices and lightnings () = a Divine state in which there was revelation; for voices which are the sounds of thunders, = truths Divine. Illustrated. AC 8914.
The voice of the trumpet () = heavenly or angelic truth conjoined with Divine, thus what is general of revelation. Explained. AC 8915.
God answered him in a voice () = the Divine truth a quo.
The voice (of the Spirits of the moon) was emitted from the abdomen...

Hear His voice () = obedience to the precepts which are from the Lord; for... a voice, when predicated of the Lord, = truths Divine, thus the precepts which are from the Lord... and therefore also the Word and doctrine from it, are the voice of Jehovah. References.

All the people answered with one voice () = reception in the understanding by those who are truly of the Church; for... voice = the confession which comes forth from the understanding; for the things which belong to the mouth... correspond to the intellectual part...
Truth Divine, or the Lord in ultimates, is meant (also) by the voice of His words like the voice of a multitude ().
The voice of the wings () = the truth of faith from good.

His voice shall be heard () = the influx of truth with those in the Heavens and on earth; for... a voice, when predicated of Aaron, by whom the Lord is represented, = Divine truth; for a voice = the annunciation of it, and... it is therefore with those in the Heavens and on earth; for the Divine truth infills all things of Heaven, and makes all things of the Church. Such an annunciation was represented by the voice from the bells of gold...
That voice, in the Word, = the Divine truth which is heard and perceived in the Heavens and on earth. Illustrated.
The voice of strangers () = falsity.

The sound from the bells is (here) called a voice; and in other passages the sounds from trumpets, and also from thunders, are called voices, and by these in like manner are signified Divine truths...
The voice of Jehovah = the Divine truth which proceeds from His Divine good. Illustrated.
Thou hearest the voice thereof () = that these things come to perception in the external or natural man; voice = what is annunciated from the Word. See AE 419:6.

Joshua heard the voice of the people in their shouting () = a survey and apperception as to what was the quality of the interiors of that nation... for by voice, in the Word, is signified the interior voice, which is the thought, and thus the interior quality in respect to truth or falsity, for the thought comes from one of these...

There is a voice of war in the camp () = an assault on truth and good... by falsities and evils... For a voice = thought and affection, which are the interior things of the voice, thus the quality of the interiors.

It is not the voice of a shout-clamor is for victory, and it is not the voice of a shout for a Thing that is lost () = that Heaven acts on one side, and Hell on the other; thus falsity against truth, and truth against falsity; for the voice of a shout... = the quality of the interiors of that nation.

The voice of a miserable shout do I hear () = the lamentable state of their interiors... for what is lamentable is expressed in the Original Language by a voice, which = a shout, an affection, and misery; thus a miserable shout; and, as a voice = the quality of the interiors, the voice of a miserable shout = the lamentable state of the interiors.
The voice of Jehovah, which, in this case () is thunder, = Divine truth, or the Word, in its power.

I heard behind me a great voice as of a trumpet () = a manifest perception of Divine truth revealed from Heaven. A great voice, when heard from Heaven, = the Divine truth. Illustrated. (Why it was heard as a trumpet. Explained.) AE 55.
His voice as the voice of many waters () = Divine truth natural. ( = Divine truth in ultimates. AE 71.)
Thus the voice of many waters = the Lord's Divine truth in the Word. Illustrated.

If anyone shall hear My voice () = him who believes in the Word... To hear the voice = to believe in the Word; for the Divine truth of the Word is the voice of Jehovah. ( = him who pays attention to the Lord's precepts... for My voice = the truths of the Word, of doctrine, and of the derivative faith, thus the precepts. AE 249.)

The first voice which I heard was like that of a trumpet speaking to me () = the Divine influx... and the consequent manifest perception. ( = a revelation now of future things, clear and manifest. AE 261, AE 262.)
Voices like trumpets are heard in Heaven when convocations and disposings in order are taking place.
Voices (out of the throne) () = instruction from the Lord. Explained. ( = the perception of the Divine truth in the Heavens from the Lord. AE 273.)

A mighty Angel proclaiming with a great voice () = Divine truth from the Lord inflowing deeply into the thought of Angels and men... A great voice = Divine truth from the Lord in power. ( = exploration by the influx of the Lord into Heaven. AE 302.)
Saying with a great voice () = confession from the heart. ( = acknowledgement in the heart. AE 337, Explained.)
Crying with a great voice () = acknowledgement from the heart. ( = adoration from the good of truth, and the consequent joy of heart. AE 459.)
Voices () = reasonings about faith alone. Explained. AE 498.

Saying with a great voice. Woe, woe, woe () = the deepest lamentation... The rest of the voices of the trumpet of the three Angels... = the exploration and manifestation of the state of the Church and of life... AE 530. AE 531.
The voice of their wings () = reasonings. AE 558.
I heard a voice () = a command from the Lord. ( = a revelation from the Lord. AE 567.)

He cried with a great voice as when a lion roareth () = a grievous lamentation that the Church has been taken away from Him. ( = a testification of severe grief on account of the desolation of Divine truth in the Church. AE 601.)
Under Thunder, see this reference.
There were great voices in Heaven () = celebrations by the Angels, ( = enlightenment and joy in the higher Heavens. Explained. AE 682.)
I heard a great voice saying in Heaven () = the joy of the Angels of Heaven. AE 744.

I heard a voice from Heaven as the voice of many waters () = the Lord speaking through the New Heaven from Divine truths... For when a voice is heard from Heaven, it is from the Lord. Illustrated. ( = a Glorification of the Lord from the Divine truths which are from Him. Explained. AE 854.) AR 615. AR 616. AE 855. AE 856.
Saying with a great voice, Fear God () an admonition that they should not do evils, because they are contrary to the Lord. ( = an exhortation. AE 873.)
I heard a voice from Heaven saying unto me () = a prediction from the Lord. ( = consolation by the Lord after temptations. AE 897.)

Crying with a great voice to Him that sat on the cloud () = a supplication of the Angels of Heaven to the Lord. ( = an annunciation after exploration! or visitation... For a voice involves the things that are said. AE 910.)
I heard a great voice out of the temple () = an influx from the Lord from the inmost of Heaven. Explained. ( = a manifestation by Divine truth from the Word. AE 959.)
There came a great voice out of the temple of Heaven from the throne () = a manifestation by the Lord from the inmost of Heaven. AE 1013.
Voices, lightnings, and thunders () = reasonings, falsifications of truth, and argumentations, from the falsities of evil in the Church with those in faith alone... AE 1014.

I heard another voice from Heaven () = an exhortation from the Lord to all, both those in that religiosity and those not in it. ( = an exhortation to those who are in truths and the good of life, to beware of such... A voice from Heaven being heard, means from the Lord through the Word; for all things which man imbibes from the Word are a voice from Heaven. Further Explained. AE 1106.)
The voice of harpers, etc. shall be heard in thee no more () = no spiritual affection... Voice means sound, and all sound corresponds to affection... ( = no longer any joys... AE 1185.)
(Nor) the voice of a mill () = no searching for, investigation, or confirmation of, spiritual truth... ( = no understanding of truth from the will of good. AE 1187.)

(Nor) the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride () = no conjunction of good and truth... Voice, here, = joy, because it is that of the bridegroom and bride. ( = not any joy from the conjunction of good and truth. AE 1189.)
A voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God... () = an influx from the Lord into Heaven, and thus the unanimity of the Angels that (these) should worship the Lord... AE 1209.

I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunders, saying, Alleluia... () = the joy of the Angels of (the three Heavens)... A voice = the joy of the worship, confession, and celebration of the Lord. Explained. ( = a Glorification of the Lord by all in the Heavens, a Glorification of Him from truths, and a Glorification of Him from the goods of love... AE 1214-1216.) AR 803. AE 1196.
When Angels speak to a man, they never speak to him from Heaven, but the voice which is heard thence is from the Lord through Heaven...
The Angel... cried with a great voice () = the Lord calling together (all such) from Divine zeal. For a voice, or an influx from the Lord from the Divine Love, is from Divine zeal...
I heard a great voice out of Heaven saying () = the Lord, from love, speaking and evangelizing... By a great voice is meant speech from love; for great is predicated of love.
A voice was (then) heard from Heaven... CL 55:3.
When the voice begins to become masculine.
Voices heard coming from the hoofs of horses, from animals, etc. SE 330. SE 1770.
The voice (of the Sirens) was heard as if from a Society of the good. SE 4598.
Man cannot be enlightened by a living voice from Heaven. Explained.
Voice = the proceeding Divine, which is the Divine truth. AE 261:3. AE 644:19.

A voice which is heard from Heaven with those who are in the spirit, is wont to be heard like a human voice; but this was heard like a trumpet speaking, because it was clearly perceived by the Angels...
Voice is predicated of truth. AE 304:50. Illustrated AE 419:13.

For the voices which descend from the Inmost Heaven into the hearing of a man, are heard (as thunder); for they fill the whole brain, and propagate themselves thence towards the hearing... It is different with the voices which descend from the Middle Heaven, which, being attended with enlightenment, are heard... like voices (or words) of speech. Explained.
The voice of the horseman and the bowmen () = reasoning...
Voice = influx.
He cried with a great voice () = a Divine command. AR 346.

Such (reasonings, etc.) are heard in the Spiritual World as the voices of a murmuring, clashing, threatening, and fighting multitude; and, at a distance, where they are not heard, they appear as thunder and lightning... As these things originate from the flowing down of the Divine good and truth... the voices, thunders, and lightnings, when heard and seen by the good, = the Divine truth as to perception and enlightenment...
I heard a voice from Heaven saying unto () = a command from the Lord.

The voice which I heard from Heaven again spoke to me and said () = the exploration of the men of the Church as to the quality of their remaining understanding of the Word... for (this) voice from Heaven involves these things.
A voice in the window () = the preaching of falsity.

They heard a great voice from Heaven saying to them- () = the Lord's Divine Providence... For by a voice from Heaven is signified all that proceeds from the Lord, which, in general, is called the Divine truth; and, with us in the world, the Word; thus, in special, every precept and commandment in the Word. This is called a voice from Heaven because it has descended from the Lord through Heaven... That it is the Lord's Divine Providence which is iere signified by a voice from Heaven, is because it is treating of the state of Heaven and the Church at its end... AR 512.
Voices () = reasonings. AR 530.
To know and hear the Lord's voice () = to do His commandments.
A great voice () = exhortation. AR 633.
They who hear the voice of the Son of God () = those who live according to His commandments.
A great voice () = joy of heart. Explained. AR 755.
